plugins.label: Map Range
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Remap a number from one range into another (e.g. 0–100 °C → 0–1, or sensor raw → percent). Clamps to the output range by default.

properties.label: Value
properties.help: Incoming value to remap

properties.label: Clamp output
properties.help: If on, result stays between out min and out max

plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
  local v, a, b, c, d = {value}, {in_min}, {in_max}, {out_min}, {out_max}
  local span = b - a
  if span == 0 then return c end
  local t = (v - a) / span
  local r = c + t * (d - c)
  if {clamp_out} then
    local lo, hi = math.min(c, d), math.max(c, d)
    if r < lo then r = lo elseif r > hi then r = hi end
  end
  return r
end)()

plugins.label: Lerp
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Linear blend between A and B by T (0 = all A, 1 = all B). T is clamped to 0–1.

properties.label: T (0–1)
properties.help: Blend factor. Wire a percent source and divide by 100 upstream, or use 0–1 directly.

plugins.label: Threshold
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Compare a value to a threshold. Outputs either a boolean-style 0/1, or passes the original value when the condition holds (gate mode). Useful for glow triggers, swap triggers, and alert bands.

properties.label: Output
properties.help: binary → 1 when condition holds. gate → original value when true, else 0. invert_binary flips the 0/1.

properties.label: Equal ε
properties.help: Tolerance used only when Mode is Equal

plugins.label: Deadzone
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Zero-out values whose absolute magnitude is below a threshold. Optional soft ramp so the edge is not a hard cliff. Great for noisy net/CPU deltas and joystick-style inputs.

properties.label: Deadzone
properties.help: Values with |value| < deadzone become 0 (or are scaled in soft mode)

properties.label: Soft edge
properties.help: If on, rescale so the deadzone is removed and the rest maps smoothly outward

plugins.label: Smooth (EMA)
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Exponential moving average — tames jittery sensors (CPU, net, GPU) before they hit rings/bars. Each node needs a unique Slot so parallel smoothers do not share state.

properties.label: Alpha
properties.help: 1 = no smoothing (follow input). Smaller = heavier lag. 0.15–0.3 is a good starting band for CPU/net.

properties.label: Slot
properties.help: Unique integer per Smooth node in the project (1, 2, 3…). Shared slots share the same smoothed memory.

plugins.label: Temp Convert
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Convert temperature between Fahrenheit and Celsius. Wire your weather (or any °F/°C source) in, pick the direction, and feed rings, labels, or thresholds in the unit you want.

properties.label: Temperature
properties.help: Incoming temperature. Accepts a weather/source node that reports °F or °C.

properties.label: Round to
properties.help: Optional rounding so labels stay tidy (e.g. 21.3 instead of 21.333…).

plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
  local v = {value}
  local dir = '{direction}'
  local out
  if dir == 'c_to_f' then
    out = v * 9 / 5 + 32
  else
    out = (v - 32) * 5 / 9
  end
  local d = '{decimals}'
  if d == '0' then return math.floor(out + 0.5)
  elseif d == '1' then return math.floor(out * 10 + 0.5) / 10
  elseif d == '2' then return math.floor(out * 100 + 0.5) / 100
  end
  return out
end)()

plugins.label: Chain Select
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Chain up to 10 gate/threshold inputs into a single index (1–10). Wire each Threshold into Gate 1…Gate 10. Output is the active slot — feed it into Image Chain, Chain Pick, or compare nodes so only one branch is “on”.

properties.label: Gate 1
properties.help: Wire Threshold 1 (or any 0/1 signal). Treated as true when value ≥ truth threshold.

properties.label: Gate 2
properties.help: Wire Threshold 2 (or any 0/1 signal). Treated as true when value ≥ truth threshold.

properties.label: Gate 3
properties.help: Wire Threshold 3 (or any 0/1 signal). Treated as true when value ≥ truth threshold.

properties.label: Gate 4
properties.help: Wire Threshold 4 (or any 0/1 signal). Treated as true when value ≥ truth threshold.

properties.label: Gate 5
properties.help: Wire Threshold 5 (or any 0/1 signal). Treated as true when value ≥ truth threshold.

properties.label: Gate 6
properties.help: Wire Threshold 6 (or any 0/1 signal). Treated as true when value ≥ truth threshold.

properties.label: Gate 7
properties.help: Wire Threshold 7 (or any 0/1 signal). Treated as true when value ≥ truth threshold.

properties.label: Gate 8
properties.help: Wire Threshold 8 (or any 0/1 signal). Treated as true when value ≥ truth threshold.

properties.label: Gate 9
properties.help: Wire Threshold 9 (or any 0/1 signal). Treated as true when value ≥ truth threshold.

properties.label: Gate 10
properties.help: Wire Threshold 10 (or any 0/1 signal). Treated as true when value ≥ truth threshold.

properties.label: Truth ≥
properties.help: A gate counts as ON when its value is ≥ this (use 0.5 for 0/1 thresholds, or 80 if you wire raw percents).

properties.label: Mode
properties.help: Which gate wins when several are true at once.

properties.label: When none ON
properties.help: Output if no gate is true (0 = nothing selected).

plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
  local truth = {truth}
  local mode = '{mode}'
  local gates = {{ {gate_1}, {gate_2}, {gate_3}, {gate_4}, {gate_5}, {gate_6}, {gate_7}, {gate_8}, {gate_9}, {gate_10} }}
  local first_i, last_i = 0, 0
  for i = 1, 10 do
    local g = gates[i]
    if type(g) ~= 'number' then g = tonumber(g) or 0 end
    if g >= truth then
      if first_i == 0 then first_i = i end
      last_i = i
    end
  end
  if first_i == 0 then return {none_value} end
  if mode == 'last' or mode == 'highest' then return last_i end
  return first_i
end)()

plugins.label: Chain Pick
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Pick one of up to 10 values by index. Wire Chain Select → Index, and set Value 1…10 (constants or other nodes). Useful for per-slot rotation speed, opacity, or scale.

plugins.label: Image Chain
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Up to 10 images, one visible at a time. Wire Chain Select into Active index; set Image 1…10 paths. Shared position, size, and rotation apply to whichever slot is active — so thresholds can advance which art is spinning.
plugins.lua_helpers:
local function _cs_chain_basename(p)
  if p == nil then return nil end
  p = tostring(p)
  if p == '' then return nil end
  return p:match('([^/\\]+)$') or p
end
local function _cs_chain_load(p)
  local base = _cs_chain_basename(p)
  if not base then return nil end
  local candidates = {
    p,
    (IMAGES_DIR or '') .. '/' .. base,
    (THEME_DIR or './') .. 'images/' .. base,
    (THEME_DIR or './') .. 'assets/' .. base,
  }
  for _, c in ipairs(candidates) do
    if c and c ~= '' then
      local img = load_image_cached(c)
      if img ~= nil then return img end
    end
  end
  return nil
end

properties.label: Active index

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local idx = math.floor(({index}) + 0.5)
  if idx < 1 or idx > 10 then return end
  local paths = {
    [1] = {path_1}, [2] = {path_2}, [3] = {path_3}, [4] = {path_4}, [5] = {path_5},
    [6] = {path_6}, [7] = {path_7}, [8] = {path_8}, [9] = {path_9}, [10] = {path_10},
  }
  local p = paths[idx]
  if p == nil or p == '' or p == 0 then return end
  -- path props may resolve to a quoted string or a raw path; normalize
  if type(p) == 'number' then return end
  local img = _cs_chain_load(p)
  if img == nil then return end
  local op = {opacity}
  if type(op) ~= 'number' then op = tonumber(op) or 1 end
  if op > 1 then op = op / 100 end
  if op < 0 then op = 0 elseif op > 1 then op = 1 end
  draw_image_fit(cr, img, {x}, {y}, {size}, {rotation}, op)
